limits.scope: All 82 assigned URLs were read completely as individual saved texts, without template-based copying. The date-rescheduling cross-reference was separately authorized and fully read. All 94 selected associations remain verbatim; body applicability can extend beyond them.
limits.classification_basis: Purpose and event facts were recorded by individual reading. Metadata matching only supplied explicitly labelled CUSIP references for date/term descriptions; it did not classify documents.
limits.financial_values: Amounts, coupons and yield ranges seen in source text or rendered originals were not converted, calculated or placed in the public ledger. No feature, cohort support, market array, model or score was read or computed.
limits.conditional_scope: Unambiguous conditional wording is classified as conditional, not a demonstrated event or a numeric trigger test. Precise final-result obligations remain. Other reviewers' confirming notices may resolve them during consolidation.
limits.correction_scope: No allocation-error correction is stated in these 82 documents. This is not a claim about the other 171 selected notices or unlinked archive history. A same-day realized identity confirmation is not automatically a correction to previously published bidder amounts.
limits.clocks: Each release date comes from a separately checked header read in its complete text. Bid deadlines, original issue dates, auction dates, conditional dates and later rescheduling clocks are distinct. Hashes pin current captures, not immutable historical delivery.
limits.field_semantics: affected_fields includes schedule/conditional/identity fields described by the notice; it does not imply a financial result correction. An empty explicit_unchanged_fields list means no explicit unchanged-field boundary was quoted, not a finding that other data changed.
